question.text: Which of the following funds qualifies as an 'Investment Fund' under Section 115UB of the ITA for pass-through status, post Finance Act 2023 amendment?

answer.text: A Cat III AIF registered with SEBI
A venture fund in a tax-haven not registered with SEBI or IFSCA
Any PMS provider providing discretionary services
A Cat I or Cat II AIF registered with SEBI OR a fund regulated under the IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2022

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 115UB (updated by Finance Act 2023 w.e.f. 1 April 2023) defines 'Investment Fund' as a Category I or II AIF registered with SEBI OR a fund regulated under the IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2022 (GIFT-City). Cat III is EXPRESSLY EXCLUDED from 115UB pass-through. PMS is NOT a 115UB fund. The Trap: Option A — Cat III excluded. Option B — registration with SEBI/IFSCA is mandatory. Option C — PMS is governed by different sections (no pass-through). Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B (PM exam) clarifies PMS is NOT pass-through. XIX-C tests the precise 115UB perimeter. Manager's Pro-Tip: When structuring a GIFT-City feeder AIF, confirm with the fund administrator that your IFSCA registration is correctly reflected in the PAN-tax-status records so that Section 115UB benefit is not denied in scrutiny. Many teams hit this on first tax audit.
